context_compaction.note: The scaffolds.py history handling is not in the bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Our primary experimental setup relied solely on text-based feedback from test runs and did not utilize the visualization
observation_format.note: Statement images are opt-in via use_statement_image (default False). Visualizations are optional.

tool_call_format.note: The scaffold parses code out of the model response. The parser source is not in the bundle.

tool_count.note: No tool list was found for the scaffolds, and ALE-Agent code is not in the bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Each generation appears to emit a complete solution program. This is inferred from the README example.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: There is a MCP (Model Context Protocol) server feature to simplify the use of ALE-Bench as a tool.
protocol_standardization.note: This is an MCP server exposing the benchmark, not an agent-side client.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: We employ a best-first-search-based algorithm to generate and refine answer candidates using an LLM.
loop_primitives.note: The shipped eval tool (docs/evaluation.md) does repeated sampling plus self-refinement against public-eval feedback. Both default to 1. Tree search (ALE-Agent Method 2) is described in the paper only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: An agent receives a task and submits code.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Root path to save results and resume from
state_persistence.note: Sessions can also be saved and restarted with ale_bench.restart. The resume granularity of the eval tool is unclear.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Self-Refinement**: Iteratively improve the selected solution using feedback from evaluation results
self_verification.note: The harness runs a public evaluation (scorer on test cases) and feeds the result back.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: | `n_repeated_sampling` | int | 1 | Number of repeated sampling iterations |
retry_policy.note: The CLI defaults to one sample and n_self_refine=1. fixed_n is reachable via n_repeated_sampling and n_self_refine. run_eval.sh uses 15 and 16.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: | `n_self_refine` | int | 1 | Number of self-refinement iterations including repeated sampling process (`1` means no self-refinement) |
termination_condition.note: The paper session also ends on submission or when the timer expires.

cost_controls.note: Only cost estimation is shown (calc_cost.py). No budget cap was found in the evidence.

timeouts.note: Per-run: the paper states the session concludes on submission or when the timer expires (Sec. 3.2).

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Build the Docker execution images required for your target judge versions.
execution_isolation.note: This covers submitted-code execution. The LLM calls themselves run on the host.

network_policy.note: The case_runner container config is truncated.

target_domain.evidence_quote: ALE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI systems on score-based algorithmic programming contests.
target_domain.note: The domain is algorithm engineering (competitive programming). Coded as other because it does not fit the swe repository sense.
